title: JAB Lit and John Andy's Authorship
summary: JAB Lit is the literary archive of JAB Visions, tracing John Andy's development from handmade comics and early online writing through John Andy Books and into the wider company.
facts: John Andy is publicly described as an author, scholar, worldbuilder, and the founder of JAB Visions.
His early creative history includes childhood comics, original characters, Just John Andy work on Sitey and Tumblr, early novels, and fictional memoirs.

Solomon's Secrets: Sunrise is the first official published artifact listed by JAB Lit. It explores self-discovery, spirituality, identity, fate, free will, and the metaphysical in relation to the tangible.
Fatal Stars is listed as archive material from the John Andy Books era, not as a newly released title.
Other library material is explicitly labeled in development or coming soon and must not be described as published.
JAB Lit is intended to grow gradually as a home for books, comics, novels, essays, mythologies, excerpts, previews, and author notes.
